current_operational_recommendations: Use docs/UPSTREAM_ACCEPTANCE_BASELINE.md as the acceptance contract for all downstream product-port work.
Do not reintroduce WPF, Windows-only target frameworks, or Windows-installer assets into the active 2.0 lane.
Do not claim visual product progress from any scaffold or toy application surface.
Use the repository-local NuGet.Config to keep restore deterministic and independent of machine-wide Visual Studio fallback-folder quirks.
Close each CR with reviewed commits, pushed evidence, and a tracker update before opening the next implementation increment.
